query-mapping.description: Stats for the tests executed in builds

class.name: Porion.Queries.Build_Test_Info
class.comment: Statistics about a tests executed during the builds.

property.name: pass_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that passed.

property.name: fail_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that failed.

property.name: timeout_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that timeout.

property.name: test_duration
property.comment: the total duration of all tests.

query.name: stat-tests
query.comment: Statistics about the last project builds
query.sql: SELECT build.id AS build_id, build.number AS build_number, build.create_date AS build_date, build.status AS build_status, build.pass_count AS pass_count, build.fail_count AS fail_count, build.timeout_count AS timeout_count, build.test_duration AS test_duration FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.project_id = :project_id
